cc_d11.name: Superdense Color Code d=11, r=11, p=0.001

A_bp_computational.description: Scalar single-shot BP on monolithic graph (no SIMD batching, no multipass)

B_bp_algorithmic.description: Parallel flooding schedule + no cross-pass reweighting
+ Layered serial check schedule (in-place message updates)
+ Soft cross-pass LLR reweighting (75% conditional / 25% channel prior)

C_osd_computational.description: Full rank(H) RREF + all N columns + full O(N log N) std::sort
+ Residual-syndrome early exit during Gauss-Jordan RREF
+ Coupled Horizon-Bounded Partial Sort (K = 1.2*M column truncation + O(N + K log K) std::nth_element)

D_osd_algorithmic.description: + Naive Final-Iter OSD-0 seeded from L^(T) only
+ Trajectory Seed Diversification (Min-Syndrome Snapshot L^(t*) + 2 Damped Relay Legs)
+ Higher-Order OSD(O10/W2) & Prior-Blended alpha-ISD Seeds (alpha in {0.35, 0.65})
